patch.value: Upgrade upload-artifact to v7 without breaking the self-host gate

Adopt the current pinned actions/upload-artifact v7 release while keeping pm-vcs's committed self-host bundle byte-equivalent to every tracked source change. Dependabot PR #13 changed the workflow alone, so both Node CI jobs correctly rejected its merge result at accept:self-host.

CI pins actions/upload-artifact v7.0.1 by immutable commit SHA; selfhost.bundle is regenerated from the exact committed source; npm run accept:self-host passes from a clean commit; Node 22 and Node 26 checks pass; production audit, package, changelog, tracker health and privacy release blockers remain honestly reported
